structure.unit: State Authorities, Boards, Commissions, Councils, Foundations and Other Collegial Bodies

law.catch_line: Office of the Attorney General to provide instruction to Board
law.text: The Attorney General or his designee assigned as counsel to the Board shall provide instruction to the Board on its responsibilities and obligations as a supervisory board within 30 days after the initial appointment of members of the Board. Thereafter, such counsel shall provide such instruction biennially.
